messages:
Maya: Hey folks — kicking off a quick smoke/check-in for the EU edge encryption + routing changes scheduled for tomorrow morning. Can owners confirm CR status and any remaining infra deps?
Kevin: CR is ready from runtime side, left 2 small comments on the egress policy. Will address today. :eyes:
Olivia: On docs/console side, we need the new route metadata surfaced for billing tags. I'll follow up with a PR after lunch.
Sam: Eng-infra dependency: we still need the VPC peering route injected into prod-staging in eu-west region. Priya, any ETA?
Priya: Peering PR is in review — hoping for merge by EOD. Need one more infra LGTM and I'll kick the Terraform apply.
Maya: Cool. Two blockers I want to call out: 1) KMS key policy for edge-encrypted cache needs the platform role added, 2) fallback routing policy if the new region hits quota.
Kevin: For KMS, here's the snippet we tested locally:
```json
{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-platform"},"Action":"kms:Decrypt"}
```
We need security to sign off but it's standard.
Olivia: Fallback routing: can we document the chain? Current plan is: eu-edge -> eu-fallback -> global-dedicated. If any hop exceeds 95% CPU we failover to global-dedicated with KV-cache invalidation.
Sam: That matches ops doc. We should add a shorter TTL for KV cache when failover is expected, otherwise stale state will break inference for sessioned requests.
Priya: FYI, the peering apply will create the route 10.8.0.0/16 -> edge-proxy-eu. I added a note in the PR about route priority to avoid shadowing internal mgmt networks.
Maya: Great. Code review pings: @Kevin please address your two comments by 4pm PT, @Priya confirm apply and post apply smoke. I'll run the canary suite immediately after.
Kevin: Will do. Also pinging @Olivia for the console tag PR when it's ready — we want cost grouping on day one.
Olivia: Yep, working on it now. Quick question: do we use `region:eu-west-optimized` or `region:eu-west` in the model routing table? The canary expects optimized label.
Maya: Use `eu-west-optimized` — runtime will map to the right instance family. I'll add mapping to the rollout playbook.
Priya: Apply scheduled at 17:30 UTC, rolling during a 30m window. I'll post the apply output here and trigger oncall.
oncall-bot: @oncall EngOps assigned to this deploy: @Sam. ETA 17:30 UTC. Please ack with :white_check_mark:.
Sam: Acked. I'll be watching logs and tracing for KV mismatches.
deploy-bot: Deploy window opened. Canary group = 2% traffic. Routing policy toggled to allow failover to global-dedicated.
Kevin: Merged runtime CR. Pushed a tiny follow-up to fix a TTL bug.
Olivia: Console PR opened: #4823 — adds tag UI and mapping for `eu-west-optimized`.
Maya: Perfect. After canary results look good (15m), we'll expand to 20% then 50% with automated rollout. If anyone sees error spikes >1% or latency +200ms, abort and rollback.
Priya: Apply done, peering up. Posting route table diff:
```
+ route 10.8.0.0/16 -> edge-proxy-eu
+ route 100.64.0.0/10 -> internal-mgmt (priority 100)
```
Sam: Canary started. First 2m look: p95 latency +15ms, error rate 0.12%. KV hit-rate unchanged. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — leaving this thread open for any hiccups. If nothing else, I'll post final rollout plan in #eng-platform-announce after 18:15 UTC.
Kevin: One post-check: I added logs for fallback decisions (`router.fallback.reason`). Can everyone watch for that key in tracing.
Olivia: Will monitor dashboard and cost tags.
Priya: All good from infra side.
Maya: Closing loop — great job team. :party_parrot:
